functions.name: NewCBCDecrypter
functions.summary: NewCBCDecrypter returns a BlockMode which decrypts in cipher block chaining mode, using the given Block. The length of iv must be the same as the Block's block size and must match the iv used to encrypt the data.

functions.name: NewCBCEncrypter
functions.summary: NewCBCEncrypter returns a BlockMode which encrypts in cipher block chaining mode, using the given Block. The length of iv must be the same as the Block's block size.

functions.name: NewCFBDecrypter
functions.summary: NewCFBDecrypter returns a [Stream] which decrypts with cipher feedback mode, using the given [Block]. The iv must be the same length as the [Block]'s block size.

warnings.message: Deprecated: CFB mode is not authenticated, which generally enables active attacks to manipulate and recover the plaintext. It is recommended that applications use [AEAD] modes instead. The standard library implementation of CFB is also unoptimized and not validated as part of the FIPS 140-3 module. If an unauthenticated [Stream] mode is required, use [NewCTR] instead.

functions.name: NewCFBEncrypter
functions.summary: NewCFBEncrypter returns a [Stream] which encrypts with cipher feedback mode, using the given [Block]. The iv must be the same length as the [Block]'s block size.

warnings.message: Deprecated: CFB mode is not authenticated, which generally enables active attacks to manipulate and recover the plaintext. It is recommended that applications use [AEAD] modes instead. The standard library implementation of CFB is also unoptimized and not validated as part of the FIPS 140-3 module. If an unauthenticated [Stream] mode is required, use [NewCTR] instead.

functions.name: NewCTR
functions.summary: NewCTR returns a [Stream] which encrypts/decrypts using the given [Block] in counter mode. The length of iv must be the same as the [Block]'s block size.

functions.name: NewGCM
functions.summary: NewGCM returns the given 128-bit, block cipher wrapped in Galois Counter Mode with the standard nonce length.

functions.name: NewGCMWithNonceSize
functions.summary: NewGCMWithNonceSize returns the given 128-bit, block cipher wrapped in Galois Counter Mode, which accepts nonces of the given length. The length must not be zero.

functions.name: NewGCMWithRandomNonce
functions.summary: NewGCMWithRandomNonce returns the given cipher wrapped in Galois Counter Mode, with randomly-generated nonces. The cipher must have been created by [crypto/aes.NewCipher].

functions.name: NewOFB
functions.summary: NewOFB returns a [Stream] that encrypts or decrypts using the block cipher b in output feedback mode. The initialization vector iv's length must be equal to b's block size.

warnings.message: Deprecated: OFB mode is not authenticated, which generally enables active attacks to manipulate and recover the plaintext. It is recommended that applications use [AEAD] modes instead. The standard library implementation of OFB is also unoptimized and not validated as part of the FIPS 140-3 module. If an unauthenticated [Stream] mode is required, use [NewCTR] instead.
